# MongoDB

Skills that teach agents to work with MongoDB. They are copied from the vendor's repository, [mongodb/agent-skills](https://github.com/mongodb/agent-skills), at commit `c370a63`.

Connect to any MongoDB deployment (Community, Enterprise Advanced, local dev container via Atlas CLI or Atlas clusters) through a self-managed MongoDB MCP Server using your connection string.

## Install

- **BoldCreate Connect:** open **Marketplace**, find **MongoDB**, and click **Install**.
- **Cursor:** add this repository as a team marketplace, then install **MongoDB**.
- **Claude Code:** `/plugin marketplace add syncfusion/BoldCreate-Plugins`, then `/plugin install mongodb@boldcreate-plugins`.

## Skills

8 skills: `mongodb-atlas-stream-processing`, `mongodb-connection`, `mongodb-mcp-setup`, `mongodb-natural-language-querying`, `mongodb-qe-size-estimation`, `mongodb-query-optimizer`, `mongodb-schema-design`, `mongodb-search-and-ai`.

## Setup

No install-time settings.

## Before you install

It ships no scripts. The skills are guidance for the agent.

## Docs

- Vendor repository: https://github.com/mongodb/agent-skills
